title: Two Countries One Heart — EN/ES/PT (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Spanish Portuguese heritage identity diaspora
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
I carry two countries inside my chest
Australia gave me shelter, Zimbabwe gave me rest
One built my bones the other built my soul
Two countries meeting in me make me whole

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
Llevo dos países adentro de mi pecho
[I carry two countries inside my chest]
Zimbabwe me enseñó lo que significa el esfuerzo
[Zimbabwe taught me what effort means]
Australia me dio hogar pero no me quitó mis raíces
[Australia gave me a home but did not take my roots]
Soy hijo de dos mundos, de dos luces
[I am a child of two worlds, of two lights]

[Chorus — English]
Two countries, one heart
One love that holds together what is apart
Two countries, one song
The melody of who I am, where I belong

[Bridge — Portuguese, with English translation]
Carrego dois países dentro do peito
[I carry two countries inside my chest]
Zimbabwe me criou com amor e respeito
[Zimbabwe raised me with love and respect]
A Austrália me acolheu com os braços abertos
[Australia welcomed me with open arms]
Sou filho de dois mundos, dois destinos certos
[I am a child of two worlds, two certain destinies]

[Outro — All three languages]
Two countries, one heart… Dos países, un corazón… Dois países, um coração
Belonging everywhere — Pertenecer en todas partes — Pertencer em todo lugar
The gardens still growing
